description: Fields every document carries, whatever wrote it.
name: Document

description: What was done and measured when a system was first brought into operation.
name: Commissioning Record

description: Why a system is built the way it is, including calculations and trade-offs.
name: Design Report

description: Mechanical, electrical, vacuum or layout drawings, and their reference numbers.
name: Drawing

description: What happened during a shift or a run — the operational narrative.
name: Logbook Entry

description: What was done during an intervention, and what state the equipment was left in.
name: Maintenance Report

description: Vendor or in-house documentation for a device, usually not written here.
name: Manual

description: Decisions taken and who took them.
name: Meeting Minutes

description: Anything that doesn't belong to the kinds above.
name: Note

description: A controlled, step-by-step operation someone is expected to follow exactly.
name: Procedure

description: What to do when something goes wrong, including symptoms and first actions.
name: Runbook

description: Radiation, interlock, access and personnel safety — including risk assessments.
name: Safety Document

description: What a system must do or be: requirements, interfaces, acceptance criteria.
name: Specification

description: The result of a measurement or acceptance test, tied to equipment and a date.
name: Test Report

description: How a specific task is done on specific equipment; narrower than a procedure.
name: Work Instruction

description: A travelling- or standing-wave structure.
name: Accelerating Structure

description: Equipment of the access control system.
name: Access Control Equipment

description: Decides who may pass and drives the door locks of its readers.
name: Access Controller

description: What control software reaches hardware through: a terminal server, a converter, or the hardware's own network socket.
name: Access Point

description: A set of spaces entered under one access rule, through controlled doors.
name: Access Zone

description: Puts something in and out of the beam.
name: Actuator

description: One registered address: a registered node, a lease, a name. A unit with a network presence is `described by` it. The MAC here is the one the registration names; the unit's own MAC is on its Ethernet port.
name: Address Record

description: Conditions and moves air for a building or a hall.
name: Air Handling Unit

description: An instrument the survey and alignment team measures with.
name: Alignment Instrument

description: A room, hall or tunnel.
name: Area

description: The serialised box, with a purchase order.
name: Asset

description: Measures small angles of a reflecting surface.
name: Autocollimator

description: Reads a badge, PIN or biometric and asks the controller to open a door.
name: Badge Reader

description: What a beam system carries: the reference beam, separately from the topology it travels.
name: Beam

description: Measures arrival time.
name: Beam Arrival Monitor

description: Measures the bunch charge.
name: Beam Charge Monitor

description: Where a beam ends: absorbed for good.
name: Beam Dump

description: Something the beam passes through or is acted on by.
name: Beam Element

description: Detects lost particles.
name: Beam Loss Monitor

description: The route a beam takes: open (a linac, a transfer line, a laser line) or closed (a ring). Its elements are joined by `upstream of`, its branches by `branches to`, and a closed path's last element by `closes to` its first; `s` is a coordinate along it, not its topology.
name: Beam Path

description: Measures the beam's transverse position.
name: Beam Position Monitor

description: Where a beam starts: an electron gun, an ion source, a laser oscillator.
name: Beam Source

description: Divides a photon beam between two paths.
name: Beam Splitter

description: Blocks the beam.
name: Beam Stopper

description: A system that produces or transports a beam: a storage ring, an accumulator, a linac, a transfer line, a laser transport, an FEL line.
name: Beam System

description: A line of budget that commitments are charged to.
name: Budget Line

description: A building.
name: Building

attributes.description: The number it is registered under with the authority.
attributes.name: Registration number

description: A system of the building that is inspected by law or contract.
name: Building System

description: Measures the bunch length.
name: Bunch Length Monitor

description: The medium behind an endpoint: a serial line, a bus or a cable, with its line parameters. It is attached to a port of the unit installed at the position.
name: Bus Segment

description: A cable between two pieces of hardware. Classified by what it carries; a logical line (a serial line, a network path) is composed of cables and the active equipment between them, and is `carried by` them.
name: Cable Run

description: A camera.
name: Camera

description: What a thing is an instance of.
name: Catalog Item

description: A water chiller.
name: Chiller

description: Protects a circuit: trips on overload or fault.
name: Circuit Breaker

description: A ferrite device that routes RF power from one port to the next in turn, rather than back where it came from.
name: Circulator

description: A refrigerator or liquefier: the plant that makes the cold.
name: Cold Box

description: A klystron's collector: the sub-component housed inside it that absorbs the spent electron beam once it has given up its energy to the RF cavities.
name: Collector

description: An aperture limiting the beam.
name: Collimator

description: From one IOC to one endpoint: the protocol and transport the control software speaks.
name: Communication Path

description: A server or workstation.
name: Computing Node

attributes.description: The public project code (Codice Unico di Progetto).
attributes.name: CUP

description: Any agreement with obligations and a term: a supply, a service, a licence, a collaboration.
name: Contract

description: One values.yaml at one git revision.
name: Control Configuration

description: A channel, axis, gauge or supply an IOC drives — what fails.
name: Control Device

description: The control configuration, as objects.
name: Control Item

description: A named network and its address range.
name: Control Network

description: A shared control service: archiver, gateway, alarm server, logbook.
name: Control Service

description: One signal's identity in the control system: the PV or channel that carries a setpoint, a readback, a status or a measurement. Its value is read there, never stored here.
name: Control Signal

description: A pump, exchanger or valve in a cooling circuit.
name: Cooling Circuit Component

description: Rejects heat from a cooling-water circuit to the air.
name: Cooling Tower

description: A steering magnet.
name: Corrector

description: A closed-cycle cooler: Gifford-McMahon, pulse tube, Stirling.
name: Cryocooler

description: A cryostat, cold head or transfer line.
name: Cryogenic Device

description: A vacuum-insulated line between cold equipment.
name: Cryogenic Transfer Line

description: A vessel that keeps what it holds at cryogenic temperature.
name: Cryostat

description: Regulates or shuts air flow in a duct; a fire damper closes on alarm.
name: Damper

description: A storage or transport vessel for a cryogen.
name: Dewar

description: Measures the beam.
name: Diagnostic Element

description: A grating: for stretching, compressing or dispersing pulses.
name: Diffraction Grating

description: Samples an analogue signal.
name: Digitizer

description: A bending magnet.
name: Dipole

description: Samples forward and reflected power.
name: Directional Coupler

description: A panel of final circuits for a room, a rack row or a machine.
name: Distribution Panel

description: A door or gate between two spaces: its kind, fire rating and whether access is controlled.
name: Door

description: A personal or area dosimeter. Who wears it is personnel data; the doses are not kept here.
name: Dosimeter

description: A field-free length between elements.
name: Drift

description: A run of air duct.
name: Duct Segment

description: A circuit from a board to its loads: what a breaker protects.
name: Electrical Circuit

description: Equipment of the electrical distribution.
name: Electrical Equipment

description: Measures energy and power on a feeder.
name: Electrical Meter

description: A board in a crate.
name: Electronics Board

description: A crate holding electronics boards.
name: Electronics Crate

description: A lift: load, stops and its inspection.
name: Elevator

description: Lights an escape route when the supply fails.
name: Emergency Lighting Unit

description: Measures emittance; composed of screens and actuators.
name: Emittance Meter

description: Anything in the product breakdown: PBS code, work package, design status.
name: Engineered Item

description: What the design says a component needs and costs.
name: Engineering Record

description: One physical port of one unit: Ethernet, serial or a bus. It is `port of` the unit and moves with it; a Bus Segment is attached to it.
name: Equipment Port

description: A copper Ethernet cable.
name: Ethernet Cable

description: A beamline or accelerator facility.
name: Facility

description: Heats or cools one room.
name: Fan Coil Unit

description: Stops the beam and reads its charge.
name: Faraday Cup

description: An optical fibre.
name: Fibre Cable

description: The control panel detectors report to; raises the alarm and drives suppression.
name: Fire Alarm Panel

attributes.description: Loop and address on the panel, e.g. 2/045.
attributes.name: Loop address

description: Detects fire: smoke, heat or flame, on a loop of a fire alarm panel.
name: Fire Detector

description: A portable or wheeled extinguisher: agent, capacity and the classes of fire it is for.
name: Fire Extinguisher

description: A fixed system that puts out or controls fire in a volume: sprinklers, mist, gas.
name: Fire Suppression System

description: A fire compartment: an area its detectors, alarms and suppression cover together.
name: Fire Zone

description: Filters traffic between network zones.
name: Firewall

description: Measures the flow in a pipe.
name: Flow Transmitter

description: What the machine is made of, and where along the beam.
name: Functional Element

description: A cylinder or bundle: its gas, size, fill pressure and the next test.
name: Gas Cylinder

attributes.description: In the unit the detector reads: % vol for oxygen, ppm or % LEL otherwise.
attributes.name: Low alarm

description: Detects a gas, or the lack of oxygen, and alarms above or below a threshold.
name: Gas Detector

description: Equipment that stores, distributes or relieves process gas.
name: Gas Handling Equipment

description: A run of pipe that carries a gas between equipment.
name: Gas Line

description: Joins cylinders to a distribution line, with change-over.
name: Gas Manifold

description: Standby or prime power generation.
name: Generator

description: An element a model has and this catalogue has no kind for; its native type says what it is.
name: Generic Beam Element

description: A diagnostic location a model names without saying what kind: a particle monitor, a photodiode, a camera on a laser line.
name: Generic Monitor

description: Funding received for a project: programme, grant number, contribution.
name: Grant Agreement

description: Transfers heat between two circuits.
name: Heat Exchanger

description: Moves heat for heating or cooling.
name: Heat Pump

description: A high-voltage cable, such as an ion pump's.
name: HV Cable

description: Equipment that heats, cools or ventilates.
name: HVAC Equipment

description: Temperature, humidity or CO₂ sensing for control.
name: HVAC Sensor

description: Equipment of a water or fluid network.
name: Hydraulic Equipment

description: Isolates, regulates or prevents back-flow in a circuit.
name: Hydraulic Valve

description: Analogue or digital input and output.
name: I/O Module

description: A bench or rack instrument.
name: Instrument

description: A safety or machine-protection interlock.
name: Interlock Unit

description: A supplier's invoice, the order it bills, and whether it is paid.
name: Invoice

description: An EPICS IOC: the deployable unit of control software.
name: IOC

description: An iocDefaults entry: the recipe an IOC is deployed from.
name: IOC Template

description: A sputter-ion pump: the thing that trips when the pressure rises.
name: Ion Pump

description: Anything on the network: a switch, a converter, a server, a console. Site-wide: one box is one object however many beamlines reach it.
name: IT Equipment

description: A monitor, printer, phone or other peripheral.
name: IT Peripheral

description: A fact the network registry holds about equipment or a place on the network.
name: IT Record

attributes.name: Other GLPI fields

description: Anything the inventory holds. Carries the keys shared with tickets and documents.
name: Item

description: A fast pulsed magnet for injection or extraction.
name: Kicker

description: A klystron: the vacuum-tube amplifier itself, beam in, RF out.

description: A regenerative or multipass stage, seeded by an oscillator and pumped.
name: Laser Amplifier

description: A laser that emits: an oscillator, an amplifier stage or a pump laser.
name: Laser Source

description: A laser and its delivery.
name: Laser System

description: Measures 3D positions to a reflector by laser interferometry.
name: Laser Tracker

description: Focuses a photon beam.
name: Lens

description: Where something is, and the rules for reaching it.
name: Location

description: Regulates RF phase and amplitude.

description: An assembled module, as the PBS names them.
name: Machine Module

description: A named system: Vacuum, RF, Magnets, Diagnostics.

description: The magnet itself, as a physical unit.

description: Material the beam meets: a foil, window, wire, target, converter, gas target or crystal.

description: A stand, girder or support.

description: A fibre/copper media converter.

description: A mirror steering a laser beam, on a mount that motors tilt.

description: Pulsed power for a klystron.

description: Drives one or more motor axes.

description: One motorised axis.
name: Motor Axis

description: A non-evaporable getter pump.

description: A device that carries or converts network traffic.
name: Network Device

description: A VLAN or a subnet.
name: Network Segment

description: A physical quantity a model predicts and a diagnostic measures: beam.position.x, beam.intensity, optical.power. The meaning, not a value: live values stay in the control system.

description: A physical optical component: its wavelength range, coating and damage threshold.

description: The optics between a screen and its camera.
name: Optical Assembly

description: An optical component of a photon line other than a mirror, lens or beam splitter: polariser, waveplate, grating, prism, iris, filter, amplifier.
name: Optical Element

description: A lens unit.
name: Optical Lens

description: A plane, curved or deformable mirror unit.
name: Optical Mirror

description: An optical table or breadboard and how it is isolated from vibration.
name: Optical Table

description: A window between vacuum and air, or a protective window.
name: Optical Window

attributes.description: The European Commission's Participant Identification Code.
attributes.name: EU PIC

description: A company, university, research body or public agency: a party to agreements.

description: Equipment no type of its own describes yet. Its class says what it is; a class that grows (§5.5) is promoted to a type of its own.
name: Other Equipment

description: A bridge or gantry crane: safe working load and span.

description: A beam of charged (or neutral) particles.
name: Particle Beam

description: Where cables end in a rack, port by port.
name: Patch Panel

description: A photon beam: a laser, or radiation transported to an experiment.
name: Photon Beam

description: A run of pipe between two points of a circuit.
name: Pipe Segment

description: A plant system as the site names it: a cooling loop, a substation, a ventilation zone.
name: Plant System

description: A plasma-accelerator stage.
name: Plasma Module

description: A programmable logic controller.
name: PLC

description: A mains or DC supply cable.
name: Power Cable

description: Powers a magnet or another load.
name: Power Supply

description: Reduces a supply to the pressure the users need.
name: Pressure Regulator

description: A relief valve or burst disc that protects a vessel or line from overpressure.

description: Measures the pressure at a point of a circuit.

description: A roughing or backing pump.
name: Primary Pump

description: Cost, supplier, delivery and funding.

description: A vendor's product. A procedure written once for it covers every unit.
name: Product Model

description: A laser whose job is to pump an amplifier.

description: An order to a supplier, under a contract or alone.
name: Purchase Order

description: A focusing magnet.
name: Quadrupole

description: An equipment rack.
name: Rack

description: An area classified for radiation protection (its classification and access rule are the Area's).
name: Radiation Area

description: Measures radiation.

attributes.name: Authorisation

attributes.name: Reference

description: Reduces RF power.

description: Equipment that detects, alarms, suppresses or shields: inspected on a fixed interval.

description: The screen the beam strikes.
